npcs.name: Serra Dawnpike
npcs.description: City Guard Captain associated with the watch barracks office.
npcs.biography: Serra Dawnpike works as a city guard captain out of the watch barracks office, a 34-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Serra oils her scabbard while she thinks, and is rarely without sister's braid-token tied inside her bracer. Investigates Rook; mentors Tomas; ally to Dara. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to break Rook Vell's fence ring without a street war. What keeps them careful is losing Tomas the way she lost his mother. To a DM, Serra is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. A seized crate of 'scrap iron' matched Tovin's missing strongbox parts.

npcs.name: Brannic Stonehelm
npcs.description: Gate Sergeant associated with the river gate.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Brannic Stonehelm: a 76-year-old Dwarf gate sergeant moving through the river gate as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Brannic records wagon counts in a slate book, and is rarely without gate key as thick as a thumb. Reports to Serra; eyes Nedda. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to retire with the gate still standing straight. What keeps them careful is another flood year and panicked stampedes. npcs.name: Dorn Ironstep
npcs.description: Riot Shield Guard associated with market square during crowds.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a riot shield guard and someone will point you to Dorn at market square during crowds. At 29, this Half-Orc has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Dorn plants his shield like a doorframe, and is rarely without dent in his helm from a festival riot. Respects Serra; hates Bask's methods. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to be known as the guard who ends fights early. What keeps them careful is crushing someone smaller in a shove. To a DM, Dorn is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Pulled Bask Hammer off a debtor before bones broke—and got a warning look.
